name: Nie Haitao (聂海涛)
current_role: Founder, Sichuan Tengden Science and Technology (Chengdu drone maker); current title not confirmed
profile: Founder of Sichuan Tengden, a Chengdu-based maker of medium-to-large unmanned aerial systems for military and civilian use, best known for the TB-001 'Twin-tailed Scorpion' twin-engine long-endurance drone. The parent, Sichuan Tengden Science Innovation Co., is mainly owned by Fujian and Guangxi government-linked investors; per CASI he directly holds ~2%.
interesting_fact: Tengden's TB-001 'Twin-tailed Scorpion' (20 m wingspan, 35-hour endurance, ~1 t payload) was billed as China's first twin-engine mid/large high-end drone; in Dec 2017 it flew China's first large-UAV emergency supply airdrop demonstration.
